goal: Move every interactive advisory and work-probe Agent envelope to direct foreground execution and replace background notification/retrieval guidance with sequential Parent-owned result consumption, without changing advisory authority, routing, budgets, or result normalization.

acceptance.assertion: An executable structural contract enumerates every interactive advisory, Brainstorm ensemble, and work-probe envelope producer/call site; every envelope requests foreground Agent execution with run_in_background false and exposes no background override, while advisory-only authority, no-tools prompts, model routing, candidate budgets, failed-attempt accounting, result normalization, solo fallback, and Parent synthesis ownership remain deterministic.

The canonical protocol, superseded Spec clauses, packaged protocol and Brainstorm/Planner guidance require sequential foreground result consumption and Parent re-evaluation; contain no advisory acknowledgement deadline, background progress, completion push, get-result recovery, late-notification recovery, or Footer content; explicitly defer Kernel authority Review scheduling to Phase 3; remain byte-synchronized where generated; and the complete Bun repository regression passes.
